bullets.text: Close the open items on Northwind's 112-question security questionnaire for Keystone Cloud log storage.
SOC 2 Type II covers Jan–Jun with one exception (an access review 11 days late in Q2); the 12-month report is due in February.
EU residency: Frankfurt and Dublin, including backups; support ticket metadata lives in the US.
SAML SSO is on all business plans, but SCIM is Enterprise-only (about 2x the price).
Retention: deletion within 24h from primary and 35 days from backups; delete-by-query within ~6h.
July pen test found 2 mediums fixed within 30 days; AES-256/TLS 1.2+; BYOK is Enterprise-only.
SCIM is the deciding factor: under ~$2k/yr as a Business add-on is probably a yes.
Keystone legal accepts the 30-day sub-processor notification redline.
Some Northwind services still log email addresses; fix it regardless of vendor.
Laura: SOC 2 report, bridge letter and pen test summary once the NDA arrives; SCIM answer by Thursday.
Kevin: vendor risk assessment by end of next week.
Aman: forward the NDA today, update the runbook, and open a ticket to scrub emails from logs.
Were there SOC 2 exceptions? One late access review, remediated by automating reminders.
Does support metadata include log contents? Only if our engineers paste it; staff need time-limited admin approval.
Is SCIM on Business? No, it's Enterprise-only today; Laura will ask about an add-on.
Can we delete specific records for GDPR? Yes, delete-by-query via API, done within ~6 hours.
Is bring-your-own-key available on Business? No, Enterprise only.
Can SCIM be added to the Business tier, and at what price?
Exact timing of the revised DPA from Keystone legal.
SCIM answer by Thursday; revised DPA early next week; risk assessment by end of next week.

action_items.description: Forward the countersigned NDA to Laura

Add 'no pasting customer data into vendor tickets' to the data handling runbook this week
Confirm whether SCIM can be added to the Business tier, by Thursday
Send revised DPA with 30-day sub-processor notification
Write the Keystone vendor risk assessment by end of next week
Open a ticket to scrub email addresses from service logs

chapters.title: SSO & SCIM

chapters.title: Retention & deletion

chapters.title: Pen test, encryption & DPA
chapters.summary: Clean pen test, standard encryption, Enterprise-only BYOK, and the 30-day notice accepted.

chapters.title: Recap & follow-ups
chapters.summary: Documents, SCIM answer, DPA and risk assessment owners.
